verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents several export mechanisms — event data export, cohort export/upload, and Dashboard REST API returning JSON — which support partial data portability, but there is no evidence of a comprehensive 'export all your data' or full account-portability feature, nor documentation of a full open-format bulk export covering all data types (raw events, user profiles, experiments, session replays, flags configs, etc.). missing for 10: comprehensive full-account export tooling, explicit open-format guarantee across all data types, evidence of session replay/experiment config export, independent confirmation of export completeness.
